subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` attempt bounded reattach-and-replay of an accepted Gateway run before the existing automatic isolated embedded fallback on an uncertain disconnect?
rationale: This is not merely a bug repair: it changes the user-visible outcome, timing, and duplicate-side-effect tradeoff of an established CLI fallback path, and the linked canonical issue explicitly requests owner direction.

options.title: Approve recovery-first
options.body: Adopt bounded Gateway recovery before the existing isolated embedded fallback, reducing duplicate execution when the original run is recoverable.

options.title: Keep immediate fallback
options.body: Retain the current automatic isolated embedded fallback behavior and close this implementation direction without merging it.

options.title: Split by execution mode
options.body: Define a mode-specific policy, such as recovery-first for delivery-oriented runs while retaining immediate fallback for interactive stdout runs.

recommendation.title: Approve recovery-first
recommendation.body: Adopt bounded Gateway recovery before the existing isolated embedded fallback, reducing duplicate execution when the original run is recoverable.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available main-history signal is the merged fresh-session fallback implementation that this proposal changes.
